snippet.title: Katakana Hero Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Learn to read, recognize, and use katakana as you are guided by Keen Reflex through a 35-floor, ever-changing labyrinth in an addictive and educational dungeon crawler RPG!

Learning to read katakana is the second step in your Japanese learning journey and one of the first hurdles that learners struggle to overcome.

This addictive RPG dungeon crawler will have you reading Japanese in record time without all that boring study.

Wishlist it on Steam today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4950810/Katakana_Hero/
